field.Field study: **Observe.** At the end of a round, a bot with no lasting condition is within 3 inches of two enemies
**Stress test.** A bot with a lasting condition puts down an enemy
**Sample collection.** A fighter of the crew captures a downed enemy
**Social study.** A volunteer is Announced and Hyped at the same time
**Control.** A bot spends a whole activation doing nothing (both actions on Use, with nothing to use) while an enemy is within 6 inches of it
**Replication.** A Control Group fighter puts down an enemy with an attack that had the Peer review die (rule 4)

lab.Lab study: **Placebo.** A volunteer gets a good Ask the voice result and passes the roll they asked it for
**Exposure.** A volunteer ends the battle standing with exactly one lasting condition
**Peer pressure.** At the end of a round, two Control Group fighters are in base contact with the same enemy
**Long-term study.** Before deployment, name one enemy fighter: at the end of the battle, a bot is within 6 inches of them
**Double blind.** At the end of the battle, a bot and a volunteer stand in base contact with each other, neither with a lasting condition
**Negative result.** A bot's shot misses an enemy who is Announced
